info.name: Storage Usage API
info.summary: Public API for the total user storage usage
info.description:
Provides a read-only JSON endpoint with the total storage usage of all known Nextcloud users.
The value is returned in bytes and cached locally for 60 seconds. The app uses Nextcloud's file cache and does not scan the storage recursively.
**Privacy notice:** After the app is enabled, the endpoint is publicly accessible without authentication. It exposes only the aggregated storage usage, never usernames, individual usage values, file names, or file contents.
info.author: kstraessler
